description: This file defines a PHP class 'DatabaseDump' used for exporting database structures and data, along with functions and classes related to database backup and ZIP file creation. It appears to be part of a database backup module in a VTiger CRM system.

classes.name: DatabaseDump
classes.description: Class responsible for creating SQL dump files of database structures and data.

classes.name: createZip
classes.description: Class for creating zip files, adding files and directories, and facilitating download.

classes.name: createDirZip
classes.description: Subclass of createZip for adding entire directories from the filesystem into a zip archive.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Connects to the specified database, sets character encoding if utf8, and writes SQL dump of all tables and data to a file.

methods.name: file_open
methods.description: Opens a file handle for writing the zip archive.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a string to the open file handle.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Writes a string followed by a newline to the open file handle.

methods.name: addDirectory
methods.description: Adds a directory entry to the zip archive.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a file with data to the zip archive under a specific directory.

methods.name: getZippedfile
methods.description: Returns the complete zip archive data as a string.

methods.name: forceDownload
methods.description: Sends appropriate headers and forces download of the specified zip file.

methods.name: get_files_from_folder
methods.description: Recursively adds files from a folder to the zip archive.
